question: In a certain code language, SUNSET is written as RTMTFU. How will JORDEN be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

SUNSET is written as RTMTFU.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aa01323a74fbd9c617ce0564e3063a8bac0ab124f1cfcccb6ead828b0866849.png] 

Similarly,

JORDEN will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/284425d938a9498a8ca7e241839391b69746b2de113fda5e03cc4db000f860e6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"INQEFO".**
